question: How does supreme bliss arise in relation to the field of objects?
premises: Supreme bliss arises from resting in the domain of the object.
The object field can be filled on all sides with the collision of infinite objects.
Resting in that fully filled object field gives rise to supreme bliss.
inference: Therefore supreme bliss fully arises when awareness rests in the object domain, even when it is filled with infinite objects.
plain_english: Supreme bliss also fully arises from resting in the domain of the object, when the object is filled on all sides with the collision of infinite knowables.
